method: Each current known text occurrence is independently located in the actual PDF; central original PNG paper calibration maps it to pixels. Thin contiguous horizontal rules near the actual baseline are measured. A failure requires >=4 dark pixels of a non-descender letter both above and at least two pixels below the measured rule; ordinary lines below text and descenders alone do not fail this test. This is a lower-bound demonstrated overlap census, not a claim every other visual dimension passes.
implementationCause: Known text is located at the source widget rectangle bottom; several source answer rules sit above that baseline and pass through the lower non-descender glyph body. Prior semantic preflight proved text presence, horizontal fit and source appearance equality but did not measure vertical clearances from the preserved answer-rule ink.
